name: Theme Modal
description: Theme selection modal with Dark/Light radio button options. Opens from Tools > Theme... menu item. Reflects current theme state on open via theme.isDark. Apply button calls theme.setDark() and closes. Cancel / overlay click / Escape dismiss without changes.

dependencies.usage: read theme.isDark, call theme.setDark() on apply

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show modal, re-render to reflect current theme state, store onClose callback

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Render modal HTML with current theme checked, show overlay (display:flex)

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: Close modal without applying, fire onClose

interactions.name: overlay_dismiss
interactions.action: Same as cancel — close without applying

interactions.name: state_refresh
interactions.action: Re-render DOM to match current theme.isDark state
